newsitem.title: UK: EIB adds 250 bln lire to February 2007 Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: EIB adds 250 bln lire to February 2007 Eurobond.

text.p: The European Investment Bank has increased its redenominatable bond to 1.25 trillion lire from one trillion lire, joint lead managers Banca Nazionale del Lavoro, Credito Italiano and Paribas said on Thursday.
The deal will carry a 9.00 percent coupon, which will step down to 5.75 percent from February 1999 and is is redenominatable into euros after EMU.
The new tranche has an issue price of 100.75 and a reoffer price of 99.075
